Last year, the 'Cosmic Orange' colorway of the iPhone 17 Pro was an instant hit upon release, but rumors suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will replace it with a brand-new burgundy. Below is a preview compiled from the latest leaks.

iPhone 18 Pro's rumored new signature color preview

Historically, Apple's Pro iPhone models have leaned toward understated, muted tones. But with the iPhone 17 Pro, the company made a major shift—no longer confined to black and white, it boldly unveiled the eye-catching 'Cosmic Orange,' which immediately soared in popularity.

There are rumors that the company plans to continue this bold design direction with the iPhone 18 Pro.

However, Apple is not expected to stick with orange this time, and will instead offer three (possibly four) color options:

  • Burgundy / Deep Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly also a dark gray

As for whether a dark gray or black version will be released this year, rumors remain unconfirmed; but there is broad consensus on the other three colors.

Among them, the deep cherry / burgundy is expected to be Apple's key promotional signature color for the new generation.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, stating that two shades of this colorway—lighter and darker—had previously circulated online. However, he believes the correct tone should be the darker version, presenting a cherry-like purplish-red hue.

Some reports simply refer to the colorway as 'red' or 'dark red,' which may explain why some renders use a lighter, more reddish tone. However, according to the leaker, the final version will be a cherry tone with purple undertones.

What do you think of the rumored signature colorway for the iPhone 18 Pro? Let us know in the comments.
